It's merged alread and I'd say we then also go with it if there's no opposition with good arguments against. cc <@429719902363058177> <@680337202521440470> <@281967554572976128> <@628018527470616606> <@902806914252021830> Yeah we agree with this change. Nimbus EL's EVM already worked this way so that the delegated address wouldn't appear in the BAL when prior checks fail. It makes sense to do the minimal state lookups and the BAL should only include the state read/touched. please keep in mind that the PR from <@774033563732541451> needs to be extended to cover top level calls as well (process_message_call). Which currently behaves differently than inner calls. There might be a gap in tests wrt top level calls as well.

excerpts.author: b.hartnett
excerpts.content: Yeah we agree with this change. Nimbus EL's EVM already worked this way so that the delegated address wouldn't appear in the BAL when prior checks fail. It makes sense to do the minimal state lookups and the BAL should only include the state read/touched.

excerpts.author: omerfirmak
excerpts.content: please keep in mind that the PR from <@774033563732541451> needs to be extended to cover top level calls as well (process_message_call). Which currently behaves differently than inner calls. There might be a gap in tests wrt top level calls as well.
